facts.text: An AsciiDoc statement goes in parentheses, as `// (step {...})`; `// step {...}` without them is an ordinary comment that Doc Detective doesn't read.
The `//` must start its line; an indented statement isn't read.

must_not: AsciiDoc statements can be indented to line up with list item content.
Parentheses are optional in AsciiDoc statements.

run.does: that opens localhost:8092 and clicks "Standard Button"

wrong.why: clicks a button the page lacks

wrong.answer: Indentation doesn't matter in AsciiDoc comments, so the indented `goTo` is fine. The `click` step is missing its parentheses. Write it as `// (step {"click": "Standard Button"})`.
